method: Render the same close-meadow mesh, time, perspective, past camera, jitter and wind on each side. Use released V8 temporal resolve for baseline and V9 per-vertex deformation plus temporal resolve for comparison. Two constant radiances isolate geometric coverage. Compare the spatially integrated ground truth in luma levels out of 255.
reference: At every pose render each axis at 8 times the output resolution with four MSAA samples, then area-average 256 spatial samples per output pixel. No temporal history in reference.
edgeSelection: Include interior pixels when the five-point reference neighborhood spans at least six luma levels or the reference changes at least three between frames. Exclude an eight-frame warm-up. Counts accumulate across the remaining 24 frames.

metrics.meanAbsLumaError: Mean absolute luma difference from reference.
metrics.gradientError: Mean absolute error of the horizontal and vertical first spatial differences.
metrics.motionChangeError: Mean absolute error of successive frames’ luma changes versus reference.

scope: Native software WebGPU. The first two runs frame both plant cells. The third renders the center 112 by 80 pixels of a 1920 by 1080 projection, at eye height 1.58 m. These isolated two-tone tests do not measure full-scene lighting, hardware frame pacing, or subjective realism.

reproduction.baselineEnvironment: WIND_QA_BASELINE points to the V8 checkout’s dist/temporal.js
